title: Progressive Entropic Optimal Transport Solvers
tldr_zh: 沿 McCann 插值把 Sinkhorn 拆成 K 段并调度 ε_k、α_k，得到对 ε 不敏感、可证一致的 map/耦合估计器 ProgOT
tldr_en: ProgOT splits entropic OT into K Sinkhorn steps along a McCann interpolation with scheduled epsilon, giving a consistent, epsilon-robust map and coupling estimator.
key_numbers: Consistency: E||T_Prog - T_0||^2_{L2(mu)} <~ n^{-1/d} up to Poly(log n, K), with eps_k ~ n^{-1/(2d)}, alpha_k ~ n^{-1/d} (Theorem 3)
Stability: ||T_eps - T'_eps||^2_{L2(mu)} <= 3 R^2 eps^{-1} W_2^2(mu, mu') (Proposition 4)
sci-Plex map estimation: ProgOT ranked 1st over 5 drugs, e.g. Hesperadin d=256 Sinkhorn div 23.1 vs EOT 26 vs Debiased EOT 41 (Table 1)
GMM benchmark MSE d=128/256: ProgOT 0.099/0.12 vs Debiased EOT 0.11/0.128 vs untuned EOT 0.250/0.276 (Table 5)
CIFAR-10 deblur matching n=60k d=1024, sigma=4: ProgOT Tr 0.9989, KL 0.00219, 1590 iters vs Sinkhorn 0.9954, 0.02724, 2379 iters (Table 2)
